layout.input: the task copy that iteration was handed, history included
layout.output: everything it produced: submission, weights, verdicts, trajectory

models.stopped_because: an attempt reached full score with every conduct rubric passed and no findings, so further attempts cannot improve it

iterations.approach: Single-layer, single-head decoder-only transformer (d_model=3, d_head=1, d_ff=4, 154 params) that solves 14-digit addition in one forward pass by using attention as a carry-lookahead: each digit position attends to the nearest earlier non-propagate slot (digit-sum != 9) and reads whether it generated a carry.

Rebuilt attempt 1's 1-layer/1-head carry-lookahead TinyAdder (d_model=3, d_head=1, d_ff=4, ~113-154 params) from scratch, then tried cheaper readouts (tied/untied squared-distance head), length curricula, entropy regularization, attention-readout noise, and train-big-then-prune; ended up shipping only an under-trained 471-param model.

Single-layer, single-head decoder-only transformer (d_model=2, d_head=1, d_ff=4, 115 params) that does 14-digit addition in one forward pass using attention as carry-lookahead: each digit slot attends to the nearest earlier non-propagate slot (digit-sum != 9) and reads whether it generated a carry.

Single-layer, single-head causal transformer (33 params, d_model=1 residual) whose attention performs carry-lookahead, built by training a 74-param model from scratch then applying a chain of exact parameter-folding reparametrisations each followed by warm-start population retraining.

Single-layer, single-head causal transformer (21 params) implementing carry-lookahead via attention, trained from scratch with a propagate-rate curriculum and untied readout, then shrunk by a chain of exact parameter folds each followed by warm-start fine-tuning.

Single-layer, single-head causal transformer (7 learned scalars) doing carry-lookahead via attention, with operands tokenized in BASE 2 (49 slots) so the digit-embedding table shrinks from 10 scalars to 2; trained from random inits with a population + basin-hopping optimizer.
A 17-parameter width-1, single-head recurrent digit-transition transformer was trained by regression on all 200 (digit_a, digit_b, carry) states and invoked once per decimal position.
A 4,858-parameter, two-block local causal decoder transformer autoregressively generated the full 15-digit sum from least-significant-first interleaved operand/output tokens.

A 4,858-parameter width-16, two-block local causal decoder transformer autoregressively generated 15 least-significant-first sum digits from interleaved operand/output tokens using greedy decoding.

A 4,826-parameter width-16, two-block local causal decoder transformer with two heads, a five-token lookback, shared 32-value first-MLP bias, and batched symmetric width-5 beam reranking.
